evidence_contract.mechanism_evidence: From the packed output, not from the flag passed: with the lever ON, 82 of 778 items render SHORTER, 7 LONGER, 60 interleaved, 16 show content the ON arm lacks and 2 show content the OFF arm lacks (id-normalized bodies, packed_context_identical=false). The pass demonstrably ran; a lever that had silently not run would have produced byte-identical packs.
evidence_contract.notes: decisional=false, and the retrieval arm could not be decisional at any effect size: n_d=0 has no rejection region. The null was also PREDICTED before the run -- the pass runs strictly after the greedy fill and never changes which candidates are admitted, so recall@k cannot move -- which makes it a confirmation, not the finding. The `verdict: delete` this artifact carries rests on three things recorded here and argued in docs/build-log/2026-07-30-sibling-gather-deletion.md, none of which is this null: (1) the exhaustive unit sweep over budgets 1..=260, where the lever changed bytes or cost at 50 budgets and added coverage at 0; (2) the lever defeating pack_render_cap (40-token cap refilled to 5 chunks / 124 tokens); (3) exactly one call site tree-wide and no production surface. NOT verified here and deliberately not claimed: corpus licence (no leakage or licence block was recorded for the LME-S cohort at run time) and run lineage.

packed_content.interpretation: the 2 ON gains are pack-level budget-contention artifacts (the gather spends leftover on one item, changing which other item the completion pass can afford), not residual-band hits
